title: Mexican Street Corn Soup
description: A blended sweetcorn and potato soup with peppers, chilli and lime, finished with feta cheese and coriander, Mexican street corn-inspired.

ingredients.text: 1 medium red pepper, deseeded and diced
500ml vegetable stock (1 vegetable stock cube dissolved in 500ml boiling water)
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
4 x 60g wholemeal bread rolls (+ 152 kcal per roll)
Spray a large saucepan with low-calorie cooking spray and place
over a medium heat. Fry the onion, red pepper, green chilli and garlic

steps: Spray a large saucepan with low-calorie cooking spray and place over a medium heat.
Fry the onion, red pepper, green chilli and garlic for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the potato, chilli powder, 350g of sweetcorn, stock and lime juice.
Bring to the boil and then turn down the heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes, until the potato is soft.
Add 50g of the reduced-fat feta, then use a stick blender or food processor to blitz the soup until smooth.
Add the remainder of the sweetcorn and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Serve with the remaining feta cheese and a sprinkling of coriander on top. (You can cool and freeze the soup for another day, leaving off the garnish till you’re ready to defrost and reheat.)
